sections: "I listen, not see. You speak, I agree. Who am I?" -> VOICE USER INTERFACE (voice assistant,
"Icons, buttons, colors bright — I let you click from left to right." -> GUI
"No clicks, just keys — you talk to me with letters, please." -> CLI
"No mouse or keys in sight, your fingers make everything right." -> TOUCHSCREEN INTERFACE
(touch-based UI used in phones and tablets).
Users interact with the OS through CLI shells, GUIs, touch and voice interfaces, and batch files.
